title: Guided Meditation – Your Choices Shape Your Life
fullTitle: Soul Snack #5: Guided Meditation – Your Choices Shape Your Life
description: In today’s Soul Snack, Gary Zukav takes us on a deeply relaxing meditation journey designed to help us connect with the transformative power of intention. As we release the tension in our bodies and allow our minds to calm and clear, Gary leads us through a visualization where each action we take is symbolized by planting seeds in the field of our lives.

By understanding that our intentions – whether they arise from kindness or anger – are like seeds that shape the experiences we cultivate , this meditation helps us make more conscious, loving choices.

This meditation is a gentle reminder to plant seeds of kindness and love , fostering a life filled with connection and harmony. It also highlights the impact of negative intentions, like anger, and how choosing differently can transform our lives.
